# 1. Introduction

## Goals

This document captures the architecture decisions for the
`math-coding` project itself. We use the arc42-template format
because it gives a stable, well-known structure for the
architecture documentation.

## Quality Goals

| Priority | Quality | Motivation |
|----------|---------|------------|
| 1        | Reproducibility | The tool must be buildable from a clean checkout with one command |
| 2        | Trust | Every decision is auditable via the attestation store |
